summary.headline: BK Holdings issues KRW 2bn convertible bonds (8th series) to private investors
summary.what_happened: On Oct 27, 2026, BK Holdings CO.,LTD. decided to issue its 8th series of unsecured, private placement convertible bonds with a total face value of KRW 2bn, with proceeds designated for acquiring securities of another company. The filing was corrected on Nov 27, 2026, changing the payment date and related dates to Dec 17, 2026, with the bonds maturing on Dec 17, 2029.
summary.why_it_matters: Convertible bond issuances can lead to dilution for existing shareholders if the bonds are converted into new shares, and conversion prices may be adjusted under contractual terms. Privately placed bonds are generally sold to a limited set of investors and typically cannot be transferred for a set period after issuance.
